variants.title: Calibration of a resistance temperature device with an off-balance bridge
variants.unknown: the slope of the calibration curve at 50 °C
variants.note: No balancing: the bridge output voltage is read on a voltmeter and the resistance is worked out from it.

source.title: IEC 60751 / ITS-90 platinum resistance thermometer: A = 3.9083e-3 per °C, B = -5.775e-7 per °C^2

variants.title: Calibration of a Pt1000 resistance temperature device by the null method
variants.sample: Pt1000 platinum element (1000 ohm at 0 degC)
variants.unknown: the slope of the calibration curve at 50 °C
variants.note: Ten times the resistance of a Pt100: the slope of the curve at 50 °C is ten times larger, about 3.85 ohm per kelvin.

source.title: IEC 60751: Pt1000 industrial platinum resistance thermometer, R0 = 1000 ohm
